verdict.rationale: Semgrep ships an AI-powered feature ('Semgrep Assistant') that automatically detects complex business-logic flaws and does contextual post-processing to reduce noise, which is a limited form of built-in AI assistance, but this is narrowly scoped to triage/detection rather than a general-purpose assistant you can delegate arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: evidence of a conversational/interactive assistant interface, broader task delegation beyond triage/detection, and independent hands-on validation of the assistant's quality.
